newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Nearby corn and HRW values rise - Sept 24.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Nearby corn and HRW values rise - Sept 24.

text.p: CHICAGO, Sept 24 - FOB Gulf basis values for corn and hard red winter wheat rose in the nearbys on Tuesday while soybean positions were mostly steady.
Lower CBOT corn prices and sluggish farm movement contributed to a firmer CIF market, one dealer said.
Higher rail values sparked a rise in HRW wheat values, another dealer said.
In export news, Taiwan's FGEP corn-buying group on Tuesday bought a shipment of 54,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn from Agrex, traders said. Delivery was set for December at 89 cents over December.
